title: Attached Submanifolds Beyond Symmetric Spaces
summary: We study submanifold geometry in the presence of symmetry, focusing on submanifolds of solvmanifolds with an unusual property relative to Ricci curvature. We generalize work of H. Tamaru \cite{tamaru-11} in which he explores the geometry of submanifolds of symmetric spaces of noncompact type constructed from parabolic subgroups of the isometry group. He calls these attached submanifolds. The Ricci curvatures of attached submanifolds coincide with the restrictions of the Ricci curvatures of ambient symmetric spaces.
